Kill2BeansDescription: The mess hall cook claims two walking beans escaped from the pantry during the night shift, and nobody laughed after one of them bit through a tin spoon. Track the sprouting nuisances near the cracked planters of Area 05 and put an end to their tiny rebellion before breakfast becomes a negotiation.
Kill2BeansCompleteDescription: The beans are quiet, the cook is pretending this was always under control, and the pantry smells only mildly heroic. Good work.
Collect2CansDescription: Quartermaster Rook needs two empty cans for what he calls a calibration ritual and everyone else calls lunch equipment with delusions of grandeur. Search the alleys around Area 05, where the wind rolls old tins like nervous dice. If a can hums when you pick it up, bring it anyway. Especially then.
Collect2CansCompleteDescription: Rook accepts the cans with alarming reverence. One rattles after you hand it over, though you are fairly sure it was empty.
Collect2FishDescription: The reservoir beneath Area 05 is stocked with fish, old coins, and at least one boot that keeps returning to different anglers. Catch two fish for the night kitchen before the stew becomes theoretical. The dockhand warns you not to answer if the water bubbles in Morse code. He looks tired enough to be believed.
Collect2FishCompleteDescription: Two fish, still shining with cold reservoir light. The cook nods, then quietly checks that neither one is trying to speak.
Collect2PurpleOresDescription: Purple ore glows in the mine walls like trapped twilight and leaves a peppery taste on the air. The smith wants two chunks from the old shaft, preferably ones that do not whisper your childhood nickname. Bring them back wrapped in cloth; bare hands make the ore sulk, and sulking ore ruins good hammers.
Collect2PurpleOresCompleteDescription: The purple ore pulses once as it reaches the forge table. The smith smiles like someone who has just heard an expensive secret.
Collect2WhiteOresDescription: White ore forms where mine lamps have burned too long and miners have told too many lies. Its chalky surface stays cool even beside a torch, and the Survey Office needs two samples to test a theory involving moonlight, bad accounting, and a missing elevator key. Do not lick it. That advice is now official policy.
Collect2WhiteOresCompleteDescription: The samples leave pale dust on the counter. The clerk labels them carefully, then labels her gloves too, just in case.
Collect2CopperOresDescription: The relay pylons outside Area 05 keep coughing sparks into the dawn, which is dramatic but bad for payroll. Mine two pieces of copper ore so the mechanics can patch the wiring before the announcement system starts singing again. Fresh copper smells of rain, pennies, and the kind of trouble that can be fixed with a wrench.
Collect2CopperOresCompleteDescription: The mechanics weigh the ore, grin, and immediately begin arguing about which pylon is least likely to explode first.
Collect2BlackOresDescription: Black ore is found where the tunnels forget they are tunnels and start behaving like old basements. It drinks torchlight, stains gloves, and makes nearby compasses point toward embarrassing memories. The armorer needs two pieces for a shield order marked confidential, urgent, and somehow sticky. Try not to listen too closely while mining.
Collect2BlackOresCompleteDescription: The armorer locks the black ore away in a drawer with three bolts and one nervous little prayer. Payment, thankfully, is less mysterious.
Collect2ChamomileDescription: The infirmary is out of chamomile, which means the patients are restless and Doctor Mira has started threatening people with educational pamphlets. Pick two blossoms from the windy lots beyond Area 05, where the flowers smell of honey, dust, and stubborn survival. Avoid the bees if possible; they have unionized.
Collect2ChamomileCompleteDescription: Doctor Mira brews the chamomile at once. The room exhales, the patients soften, and even the clipboard looks less judgmental.
Collect2WoodsDescription: The eastern fence groans every time the wind changes its mind, and last night it started groaning in complete sentences. Gather two sturdy logs from the scrub forest so the carpenters can reinforce the posts before the fence develops opinions. Good wood should smell sharp, green, and only faintly offended.
Collect2WoodsCompleteDescription: The carpenters take the logs and get to work. By sundown, the fence is back to normal groaning, which everyone agrees is progress.
Collect2CookedFishDescription: Two cooked fish are needed for a guard post meal, because morale drops quickly when dinner looks back at you. Find or prepare a pair with crisped skin, warm steam, and enough salt to convince tired sentries that civilization still exists. The captain says it is strategic logistics. The guards call it supper.
Collect2CookedFishCompleteDescription: The cooked fish vanish into grateful hands. For three whole minutes, the guard post is peaceful except for chewing.
Collect2SushiDescription: Archivist Pell insists that proper research requires two pieces of sushi and a quiet room, in that order. Bring him neatly rolled bites of rice and fish before his notes become more dramatic than accurate. The best sushi carries the scent of vinegar, sea wind, and someone briefly believing they can organize the archives.
Collect2SushiCompleteDescription: Pell accepts the sushi, straightens his papers, and immediately loses one under the plate. Scholarship marches on.
Collect2PurpleBarsDescription: The forge crew needs two purple bars for a prototype latch designed to keep storage doors shut during dimensional weather. Each bar should gleam like bottled dusk and ring softly when tapped, as if embarrassed by its own importance. The foreman says the old latch escaped last week. Nobody has found the hinges.
Collect2PurpleBarsCompleteDescription: The foreman lines up the bars and listens to their faint chime. He looks relieved, which is worrying in a professional way.
Collect2WhiteBarsDescription: White bars are needed for lantern frames in the deep tunnels, where ordinary metal sweats and loses its courage. Bring two clean ingots to the maintenance desk. They should feel cool through your gloves and shine without throwing shadows. The technician promises they are for safety, then hides a diagram titled Absolutely Not A Portal.
Collect2WhiteBarsCompleteDescription: The technician files the white bars under maintenance supplies and very deliberately turns the folder face down.
Collect2CopperBarsDescription: The radio room smells of burnt dust again, which means the coils are hungry for copper. Deliver two copper bars before the evening broadcast turns into static, poetry, or both. Good copper carries warmth in the palm and a sunset shine, practical enough for machines and pretty enough that engineers pretend not to notice.
Collect2CopperBarsCompleteDescription: The radio operator slots the copper bars into place. The speaker clears its throat and, mercifully, broadcasts words instead of feelings.
Collect2BlackBarsDescription: Two black bars are required for a lockbox meant to hold evidence from the north warehouse incident, which everyone describes differently and nobody describes twice. The bars should be dense, lightless, and unpleasantly smooth, like polished midnight with paperwork attached. Deliver them to Security before the evidence develops better travel plans.
Collect2BlackBarsCompleteDescription: Security signs for the black bars with a pen that stops working halfway through. They decide that still counts.
Collect2HealthPotionsDescription: The training yard has produced three bruised recruits, one dented helmet, and a heroic misunderstanding of the word dodge. Bring two health potions to the instructor before pride becomes the only remaining medicine. A proper potion smells of mint, iron, and optimism, with a fizz that sounds like tiny applause.
Collect2HealthPotionsCompleteDescription: The instructor takes the potions and calls the recruits back into formation. The potions look more prepared than the recruits do.
AmmoTemplateDescription: An empty special gear slot for weapon support items.
AmmoArrowDescription: A bundle of straight arrows ready for a bow. For now it can be equipped in the ammo slot.
AmmoRuneDescription: A small rune etched with focused magic. For now it can be equipped in the ammo slot.
AmmoFeatherDescription: A light feather prepared as a weapon support item. For now it can be equipped in the ammo slot.
AmmoOilDescription: A vial of weapon oil for coating a blade. For now it can be equipped in the ammo slot.
